name: Oil & Natural Gas Corpn Ltd
about: ONGC is the largest crude oil and natural gas Company in India, contributing around 71 per cent to Indian domestic production
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] [2] The company is India’s largest crude oil and natural gas company, with in-house capabilities across the exploration and production of Oil and Gas and related oil-field services. Its crude oil serves as a key raw material for downstream companies like IOC, BPCL, HPCL and MRPL, which process it into products including petrol, diesel, kerosene, naphtha and LPG. It has produced 2,152 MMTOE of oil and gas to date. In FY26, the company produced 73% of India’s crude oil and 57% of its natural gas, accounting for 64.3% of the country’s total hydrocarbon output.
pros: Stock is trading at 0.77 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 36.3%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.9% over last 3 years.
